opening.argument: The video delivers a concrete, self-contained tutorial for blocking pop-up windows in Safari on a Mac. It directs the viewer through the relevant menus and settings, including the instruction to “Click on the Safari menu and then click on Preferences. Click on the Security tab and then select the checkbox next to Block Pop-up Windows.” The demonstrated setting and confirmation dialog correspond directly to that procedure, while the title identifies the same practical subject. Although a closing subscription prompt and iYogi branding are present, the material does not connect either to a payment request, credential request, investment solicitation, or deceptive outcome. The observable content therefore supports an educational technology demonstration, with no stated basis for treating it as deceptive.
